personnelNotes: This charter names a contact person per division at the foot of each service rather than publishing a staff roster. The people listed here are those contacts, not a complete list of who works at the office. Their mobile numbers appear in the feedback mechanism.
Steps name positions - Administrative Aide I, Sanitary Inspector III, Nurse or Midwife on Duty - because that is what the charter's Person Responsible column records.

This is the 2023 edition. Every other office hub on this site carries a 2026 First Edition charter; no 2026 edition of the City Health Office charter has been published, so fees, times and named contacts here are three years older than the rest of the site.

feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Fill in a feedback form at the office, or call the division contact directly. Each division publishes its own number alongside the City Health Officer's.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The office asks short questions, considers the client's experience, acts on what it hears and shares the feedback with the whole office. Complaints are filed on Form 3 from the Public Assistance and Complaint Desk, dropped in the PACD box, and answered by getting the facts, offering a solution and, where warranted, disciplining the employee concerned.
